runtime.implementation: src/transformer/trellis_hc.h included by the existing transformer Trellis executor
runtime.ownership: Optional session-owned metadata and buffers on the SAME canonical TrellisRequest; immutable model/backend-owned embedding, HC and norm handles are borrowed
runtime.setup: Additional quota query, transactional unpublished setup, no live upgrades. Can combine with existing producer/attention/index/SWA/KV/rows/Engram resources
runtime.begin: CURRENT staged raw IDs -> existing pinned row-stage slot -> I32 device IDs -> immutable BF16 embedding -> four F32 streams. Nonblocking BUSY retry leaves carry/phase unchanged; carry resets once per forward
runtime.mix: Enforce all 2*layers sites in order. At attention sites run optional Engram first; previous-site pre collapses F32 streams (stream zero initially), own pre/post/comb are published; normalize ORIGINAL F32 collapsed input directly to existing F16 FFN input buffer
runtime.apply: Only matching current site ticket accepted; exact same-request external F16/F32 branch. In-place source residual apply consumes saved post/comb, then advances one site. Two disjoint ping-pong pre buffers preserve carry
runtime.finish: After every site: original vendor FP32 carried-pre head collapse with final FFN pre, then final F32-input normalization to F16. Returns head input; no vocabulary projection or logits publication
runtime.failure: Backend/lease rejection or failure conservatively destroys/drains the entire canonical request. Pending host history/position remain unchanged. Caller must reset/replay backend state; host abort is not GPU rollback
runtime.commit: Controller never commits history or position. Whole-model caller must finish every branch and vocabulary projection, fence successfully, then publish/commit
runtime.tickets: Bind session/request generation, history epoch, controller epoch/site, tokens and all returned views. Expire after matching apply, history finalization, reuse/reset/free/failure. Current is not a completion proof
runtime.engram_adapter: Explicit original Diffbot INT4 BF16 row lookup -> Exllama F16 math adapter. Not equivalence to original Diffbot full-forward arithmetic
runtime.temporary_overhead: Each Engram still computes its existing scratch output; a second exact F32 add writes persistent HC streams into the alternate owned buffer. Two extra add kernels per forward; remove only with independent numerical and profile qualification

host_boundary.history_view: Added const raw IDs pointer to the existing staged-history view; host ticket validation includes pointer identity. Data is the owned staged copy, not caller input; no additional history allocation
host_boundary.metadata_upload: bn_backend_session_row_stage_upload_i32 reuses the first exclusive row-stage pinned slot; exact disjoint external I32 destination. No allocation/fence/source I/O or row-epoch advance. Busy/upload byte statistics include metadata; failed lease/submit poisons staging

qualified_fixture.source: Independent unchanged original HC and RMSNorm kernels, original Engram hash/row/math reference and actual checkpoint weights. Source oracle captured before candidate numerical execution
qualified_fixture.native: Actual checkpoint core330 and parameter594 handles prepared by native loaders, native tokenizer compressed map and staged history, actual row cache/DMA/decoder, two independent sessions; no reference weight upload into runtime
qualified_fixture.branches: Explicit deterministic SYNTHETIC F16 attention/F32 FFN branches. These test ordering/lifetimes, not model attention/FFN correctness
qualified_fixture.boundaries: Initial embedding, both Engram outputs, every HC partial/post/comb/collapse/pre/normalized input and residual stream, final head collapse and normalized input
qualified_fixture.faults: Host/GPU late setup failure, quotas one byte short, begin/mix BUSY unchanged retry, stale/cross-session/forged tickets, invalid branch extents, early finish, backend carry/apply rejection after queued work; reset/setup and queued profile recovery
qualified_fixture.commit_scope: Probe commits history after successful HC component completion only. This is not qualification of whole-model commit or KV/SSM rewind

qualification.sanitizers: ASan/UBSan covers new C metadata/session/controller/probe. GPU memcheck full leaks and initcheck: zero errors; zero leaked bytes. No new GPU kernel, no unbounded whole-core racecheck
qualification.existing_engram_regression: 48 calls, 115008 rows, 1933437824 exact bytes using the rebuilt engine
qualification.qwen27_strict: 192/192 sampled IDs, first words8/8, counts0/8 mismatch, word prefixes147/147
qualification.references: Original packaged cuBLAS13.1 and paired13.10 captures both preserved and replayed byte-for-byte. Native arithmetic compared against matched13.10; version differences propagate through the chain

memory.device_includes: Two persistent F32 stream buffers, partials maximum over EVERY R<=max_tokens, post/comb, two pre buffers, F32 site/head collapse, I32 IDs, 4-byte embedding error flag
memory.normalization: Reuses existing F16 FFN input buffer; shares existing request cuBLAS reserve
memory.partial_bound: R32 requires more partials than R33; planner takes the maximum over 1..max_tokens
memory.separate: Existing FFN/BLAS, Engram/row-bank/pinned quotas, full host history/session storage, shared caches, immutable model weights, allocator/context/library/driver overhead and OS page cache; not a total RSS/VRAM claim
